title: Logit Lens Across Layers
summary: Implement a small pure-Python logit-lens helper that applies per-token layer norm, projects through the LM head, and returns top-k token ids for every layer.
fairness_notes: The task is dependency-light and uses Python lists instead of torch tensors.
The grader checks exact top-k ids and deterministic tie-breaking.
anti_cheat_notes: Hidden tests require using the final token of each layer, not the first token.
Hidden tests require correct layer normalization before projection.
